summary.name: Markstream
summary.one_liner: Markstream is a streaming Markdown renderer family for AI apps, with packages for Vue, React, Svelte, Angular, Nuxt, and Next.js that handle LLM token streams without flicker.
use_cases: Rendering LLM token streams in an AI chat interface
Displaying SSE or WebSocket output as formatted Markdown
Embedding Markdown with Mermaid and KaTeX in a docs site
Rendering long documents efficiently in a web app
Adding a streaming Markdown view to a VitePress site
summary.what_it_does: Markstream is a set of Markdown rendering components for AI applications, published as packages for Vue, React, Svelte, Angular, Nuxt, and Next.js. It parses incomplete Markdown during streaming so partial syntax stays stable while tokens arrive. Code blocks appear progressively, and Mermaid diagrams render once their block closes. It also supports KaTeX math, streaming diff code blocks, and high-performance handling of large documents. The page includes a gallery of 42 built-in components that replay their Markdown as a live token stream.
notable: Incomplete-token handling so partial Markdown stays stable mid-stream
Progressive Mermaid diagrams that render when the block closes
Streaming diff code blocks and KaTeX math support
Live component gallery of 42 built-in components replaying as token streams
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page beyond the listing's #free #opensource tags; the page itself asks for sponsorship via GitHub Sponsors, Alipay, or WeChat Pay for ongoing maintenance
